command:
git fetch --unshallow -q || true
echo "== AlignedNew history"; git log --format='%h %an %ad %s' --date=short -- core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/AlignedNew.cpp | head
echo "== NotImplemented in LibcInternal"; grep -rn "NotImplemented" core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/*.cpp | wc -l
grep -rn -B3 "NotImplemented" core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/Export.cpp | head -60
echo "== libc postfix names"; grep -rhoE "[A-Za-z0-9_]+_nid_postfix" core/libs/prx/libc/include/*.hpp | sort -u > /tmp/libc.txt; wc -l /tmp/libc.txt
echo "== LibcInternal throwing exports with names"
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re,glob,subprocess
libc=set(l.strip()[:-len('_nid_postfix')] for l in open('/tmp/libc.txt'))
src=""
for f in glob.glob('core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/*.cpp'):
    src+=open(f,errors='ignore').read()
# find functions that throw and their export NID + name
funcs=re.findall(r'(\w+)_nid_no_patch\s*\([^)]*\)[^{]*\{([^}]*)\}',src)
thr=[n for n,b in funcs if 'NotImplemented' in b]
print("throwing:",len(thr))
hit=[n for n in thr if n in libc]
print("throwing with libc impl:",len(hit))
for n in hit: print(" ",n)
print("sample throwing:",thr[:80])
EOF
ls docs/dev/debt | head -300 | tr '\n' ' '
